standard.summary: 条件化训练相关设置：conditioning_data_dir 包含条件图像（如边缘图、深度图）；controlnet_model_name_or_path 指定 ControlNet 模型路径；diff 系列参数用于差异对比训练。
standard.effect: 条件化训练允许同时学习原始概念和条件化生成（如同时学习角色外观和对应的边缘图条件）。dop_weight/dpo_weight 控制不同目标的损失权重。
standard.whenToUse: 需要训练 ControlNet LoRA 或条件化 LoRA 时使用。大多数标准 LoRA 训练不需要条件化数据。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要条件化生成时不要设置（增加复杂度和计算量）。

standard_en.summary: Settings for conditioned training: conditioning_data_dir holds the condition images (edge maps, depth maps); controlnet_model_name_or_path points at the ControlNet model; the diff parameters serve difference-comparison training.
standard_en.effect: Conditioned training lets the model learn the original concept and the conditioned generation together (a character's appearance alongside the matching edge-map condition, say). dop_weight/dpo_weight set the loss weights of the different objectives.
standard_en.whenToUse: When training a ControlNet LoRA or a conditioned LoRA. Most standard LoRA training needs no conditioning data.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave it unset when you do not need conditioned generation -- it adds both complexity and computation.

advanced.principle: ControlNet LoRA 在标准 LoRA 基础上额外学习条件化控制：condition_image → ControlNet encoder → 条件特征注入 UNet/DiT。diff_target 系列用于"差分微调"（PALP/Custom Diffusion 等方法的实现）：对比 target（新概念）和 original（基础概念），只保留差异方向的更新。
advanced.tradeoffs: 条件化训练需要额外准备条件图像数据集（与训练图像对应的边缘图/深度图等），数据准备工作量是主要障碍。

advanced_en.principle: ControlNet LoRA learns conditional control on top of standard LoRA: condition_image → ControlNet encoder → condition features injected into UNet/DiT. The diff_target family implements "difference fine-tuning" (PALP/Custom Diffusion-style methods): contrasting target (new concept) with original (base concept), keeping only difference-direction updates.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Conditional training needs an extra conditioning-image dataset (edges/depth maps matching the training images); data prep is the main barrier.
